text:
Elliot: quick spike idea - let's cohort telemetry by exact low-bit execution path (fp8 / int8 / 4bit) instead of a single 'lowbit' bucket. ops + models keep tripping over hidden headwise regressions.
Priya: agree. what's the minimum we need to capture to make cohorts useful?
Elliot: per-request: model, quant_profile, precision_lane, rollout_id, token_count, avg_token_confidence, degradation_score, prompt_len_bucket, and a tiny tail-hist (3 bins). also a sample_bucket (prod/shadow/canary).
Noah: careful on cost. storing per-token probs is expensive. propose a two-level approach: always emit a compact per-request summary; capture full-token traces only for anomaly captures or 1% sampling.
Lina: for detection you mostly need aggregates. summary should include avg_conf, num_low_conf_tokens, tail_entropy_estimate. full traces only when degradation_score > threshold or during canaries.
Elliot: runtime placement: compute degradation_score in serving or post-process? runtime can trigger immediate full dump but touches the hotpath. post-process simpler to ship.
Noah: prefer post-process for initial rollout. make the serving side emit the summary proto only (no logic). analytics service computes the score and then requests full dumps from short-term storage if needed.
Priya: schema/labels: quant_profile (string), precision_lane (enum: fp8,int8,4bit,fp16), cohort (string), rollout_id (string), sample_bucket (string). retention: summaries 90d, full-traces 7d unless triaged.
Lina: security note: full traces may contain PII. add mandatory PII filter step before persisting. mark metadata with pii_filtered=true/false and block >7d retention unless sec approves. encrypt full-traces and restrict KMS access.
telemetry-bot: deploy note: canary group "lowbit-experiment-7" healthy, latency SLO 99.95% met.
Noah: proto sketch (extensible): \n```\nstring request_id\nstring model\nstring quant_profile\nstring precision_lane\nstring rollout_id\nint32 token_count\nfloat avg_token_confidence\nfloat degradation_score\nmap<string,float> extra_metrics\n```\nPriya: include sample_bucket and prompt_len_bucket. use protobuf v2 to allow safe extension.
Elliot: dashboards: build cohort matrix (precision_lane x quant_profile) with trendlines for degradation_score, avg_confidence, and cost-per-token. allow filter by rollout_id and sample_bucket.
Lina: alerts: cohort-level anomaly when degradation_score rises > 3 std over 24h or absolute > 0.5 for 1h. page eng-oncall + model owner. include link to sampled full-trace.
Noah: infra: I'll prototype Kinesis -> clickhouse ingestion and a small consumer that computes the degradation_score offline.
Priya: ops: also add a retrospective job to compute headwise deltas (per-attention-head) for flagged requests - helps model debugging.
Elliot: deployment plan: phase 1 (no runtime scoring) emit summaries + analytics + dashboards + alerts. phase 2 add optional lightweight runtime gating to request full traces when analytics flags borderline anomalies.
Priya: I'll draft an RFC with cost estimate and rollout plan. tagging @noah for proto + ingestion sketch and @lina for security review.
Noah: ack, will post proto PR and a small POC ingestion job.
Lina: security will review PII filter and retention policy; recommend default auto-redact for full traces.
Elliot: sync up tomorrow 11am for 30m to assign tasks. :thumbsup:
Priya: SG.
